value.rationale: A natural complete classification in an infinite two-parameter graph family of known interest in domination-root geometry. The blade-size parity dictates a qualitative change from two bounded nonzero real roots to a divergent negative root, with an explicit sharp asymptotic. This is not merely evaluation of a known polynomial or a single small numerical example.
